requests.prompt:
IMAGE TO VIDEO REQUEST: ONE SHORT ANIMATION CLIP.

WHAT THIS IS
A 2D sprite animation of the exact character in the attached first-frame image, preserving her exact face, proportions, hair, outfit, accessories, and hand-drawn colored pencil and ink caricature style throughout every frame.

CAMERA AND BACKGROUND
Locked static camera with zero movement. The character stays facing left with her feet planted on the exact same spot on a flat, solid pure magenta background with no shadows, lighting changes, or visual effects. Silent clip.

MOTION: BREATHING IDLE
She stands in her starting relaxed stance and breathes slowly and gently, her chest and shoulders rising and falling softly, and blinks once. Her arms, head and feet stay where they are for the whole clip.

IMAGE TO VIDEO REQUEST: ONE SHORT ANIMATION CLIP.

WHAT THIS IS
A 2D sprite animation of the exact character in the attached first-frame image, preserving his exact face, proportions, hair, outfit, accessories, and hand-drawn colored pencil and ink caricature style throughout every frame.

CAMERA AND BACKGROUND
Locked static camera with zero movement. The character stays facing left with his feet planted on the exact same spot on a flat, solid pure magenta background with no shadows, lighting changes, or visual effects. Silent clip.

MOTION: BRACED GUARD
From his starting relaxed stance, he bends his knees, tucks his chin and raises both arms once, crossing his forearms in an X in front of his face with both fists closed. He holds that braced guard, breathing gently, then lowers his arms and stands back up into his starting stance.
